scope: All 162 entries: current shader declarations, family variants, local runtime constraints, user-facing copy and bilingual parity. No new GPU benchmark or content-quality test.

recommendationPolicy.first_try: Simple general starting points, not measured quality winners.
recommendationPolicy.situational: A content or hardware-specific choice; cost does not imply experimental maturity.
recommendationPolicy.advanced: Experimental integration or a color/history workflow requiring deliberate setup.

zh-Hans.name: 放大与超分
zh-Hans.description: 改变输出尺寸，按素材选择插值、边缘重建或时序超分。

subcategories.name: 通用
subcategories.description: 适用于一般照片、视频、游戏和界面；比较清晰度、光晕与处理开销。

subcategories.name: 动画线条
subcategories.description: 适用于动画和视觉小说；比较轮廓、色块及细小纹理的保留。

subcategories.name: 像素画
subcategories.description: 选择保留像素块或平滑轮廓的方案；整数倍率通常更容易保持均匀网格。

subcategories.name: 时序重建
subcategories.description: 使用连续捕获帧重建细节；运动和深度信息有限，留意重影、遮挡与界面。

subcategories.name: 缩小与尺寸整理
subcategories.description: 用于降低分辨率，或在固定倍率放大之后整理最终尺寸。

en-US.name: Upscaling and super resolution
en-US.description: Resize an image using interpolation, edge reconstruction, or temporal upscaling.

subcategories.name: General purpose
subcategories.description: For photos, video, games, and interfaces; compare definition, halos, and processing cost.

subcategories.name: Anime and line art
subcategories.description: For animation and visual novels; compare outlines, flat colors, and fine textures.

subcategories.name: Pixel art
subcategories.description: Choose intact pixel blocks or smoother outlines; integer scales help maintain an even grid.

subcategories.name: Temporal reconstruction
subcategories.description: Reconstruct detail from captured-frame history; limited motion and depth information requires checking ghosting, occlusion, and UI.

subcategories.name: Downscaling and resizing
subcategories.description: For downscaling or fitting the final size after a fixed-scale upscaler.

zh-Hans.name: 清理修复
zh-Hans.description: 减轻噪声、色带或线条缺陷；通常先修复，再放大与锐化。

subcategories.name: 降噪
subcategories.description: 先尝试较低强度；比较噪声减轻与细小纹理的损失。

subcategories.name: 去色带
subcategories.description: 平滑天空和暗部渐变；避免过强设置抹去真实纹理。

subcategories.name: 线条修复
subcategories.description: 修整动画轮廓或线条粗细，通常放在主要放大步骤之前。

en-US.name: Cleanup and restoration
en-US.description: Reduce noise, banding, or line defects, usually before upscaling and sharpening.

subcategories.name: Denoising
subcategories.description: Start with low strength and compare noise reduction against lost fine texture.

subcategories.name: Debanding
subcategories.description: Smooth gradients in skies and shadows without erasing real texture.

subcategories.name: Line restoration
subcategories.description: Refine animation outlines or line thickness, usually before the main upscaler.

zh-Hans.name: 抗锯齿
zh-Hans.description: 平滑边缘锯齿；空间方案处理当前帧，时序方案还使用捕获帧历史。

subcategories.name: 空间
subcategories.description: 处理当前帧的边缘，适合先尝试；注意文字和细线是否变软。

subcategories.name: 时序
subcategories.description: 结合连续捕获帧的实验方案；重点检查运动重影和细线稳定性。

en-US.name: Anti-aliasing
en-US.description: Smooth jagged edges using the current frame or captured-frame history.

subcategories.name: Spatial
subcategories.description: Process edges in the current frame; check for softened text and thin lines.

subcategories.name: Temporal
subcategories.description: Experimental processing with captured-frame history; check ghosting and thin-line stability.

zh-Hans.name: 锐化细节
zh-Hans.description: 增强局部对比与边缘清晰度；注意过强时的光晕和噪声。

subcategories.name: 通用锐化
subcategories.description: 通常放在缩放后；先使用一种锐化，避免叠加光晕与噪声。

en-US.name: Sharpening
en-US.description: Enhance local contrast and edge definition; watch for halos and amplified noise.

subcategories.name: General sharpening
subcategories.description: Usually apply after scaling; start with one sharpener to avoid stacking halos and noise.

zh-Hans.name: 补帧与帧率
zh-Hans.description: 生成中间帧或限制基础帧率；与“帧率与刷新”设置配合使用。

subcategories.name: 补帧
subcategories.description: 一个效果组使用一种补帧方案；显示帧率增加不等于游戏逻辑帧率增加。

subcategories.name: 帧率调度
subcategories.description: 限制捕获与处理的基础帧率，拖动条目不改变限帧范围。

en-US.name: Frame generation and frame rate
en-US.description: Generate intermediate frames or limit the base frame rate alongside Frame rate and refresh settings.

subcategories.name: Frame generation
subcategories.description: Use one frame generator per group; higher displayed FPS does not raise the game simulation rate.

subcategories.name: Frame-rate control
subcategories.description: Limit the capture and processing base rate; moving the entry does not change its scope.

zh-Hans.name: 风格显示
zh-Hans.description: 调整颜色、亮度、纹理或复古显示风格，按观看偏好选择。

subcategories.name: CRT
subcategories.description: 扫描线、遮罩、辉光和曲面等复古效果，通常放在缩放之后。

subcategories.name: 图像调整
subcategories.description: 按观看偏好调整亮度与颜色；HDR 下请检查高光和渐变。

subcategories.name: AI 画面重塑
subcategories.description: 改变纹理与细节组织，适合愿意对比原图的进阶用户。

en-US.name: Display styles
en-US.description: Adjust colors, brightness, textures, or retro display style to suit your preferences.

subcategories.name: CRT
subcategories.description: Retro scanlines, masks, glow, and curvature, usually applied after scaling.

subcategories.name: Image adjustment
subcategories.description: Adjust brightness and color to taste; check HDR highlights and gradients.

subcategories.name: AI image enhancement
subcategories.description: Reshape textures and detail for advanced users willing to compare against the original.

zh-Hans.name: 诊断调试
zh-Hans.description: 查看运动估计与置信度，帮助定位时序处理问题。

subcategories.name: 诊断
subcategories.description: 用于查看运动和置信度，诊断色图不作为正常观看输出。

en-US.name: Diagnostics
en-US.description: Inspect estimated motion and confidence to diagnose temporal processing.

subcategories.name: Diagnostics
subcategories.description: View motion and confidence; diagnostic maps are not normal viewing output.

zh-Hans.name: HDR 组件
zh-Hans.description: 在 HDR 与 SDR 之间转换，或将 SDR 画面扩展为 HDR。

en-US.name: HDR components
en-US.description: Convert between HDR and SDR, or expand SDR images into HDR.

zh-Hans.name: Anime4K
zh-Hans.summary: 按放大、降噪或线条修复选择。S～UL 是不同模型预设，Soft 与 GAN 的纹理风格也不同。

en-US.name: Anime4K
en-US.summary: Choose upscaling, denoising, or line restoration. S–UL are model presets; Soft and GAN variants also differ in texture style.

zh-Hans.name: CAS
zh-Hans.summary: CAS 保持尺寸并锐化；CAS Scaling 同时缩放与锐化。先低强度尝试，避免叠加光晕。

en-US.name: CAS
en-US.summary: CAS sharpens without resizing; CAS Scaling also resizes. Start gently to avoid stacked halos.

zh-Hans.name: CuNNy
zh-Hans.summary: 面向动画和视觉小说的 2× 放大。原版 DN 同时降噪；CuNNy2 是另一代模型。按纹理与性能余量选规格。

en-US.name: CuNNy
en-US.summary: 2× upscaling for animation and visual novels. Original DN variants also denoise; CuNNy2 is a separate generation. Choose by texture and GPU headroom.

zh-Hans.name: FSR
zh-Hans.summary: FSR 1 的空间方案：EASU 放大，RCAS 同尺寸锐化；与 FSR2／3／4 时序超分分开选择。

en-US.name: FSR
en-US.summary: FSR 1 spatial processing: EASU upscales and RCAS sharpens at the same size. Separate from FSR2/3/4 temporal upscaling.

zh-Hans.name: FSRCNNX
zh-Hans.summary: 固定 2× 神经网络放大。通用与 LineArt 使用不同训练权重；按素材比较，不按名称推断优劣。

en-US.name: FSRCNNX
en-US.summary: Fixed 2× neural upscaling. General and LineArt variants use different trained weights; compare them on your content.

zh-Hans.name: FXAA
zh-Hans.summary: 快速空间抗锯齿；Medium／High／Ultra 改变边缘搜索预设，注意文字和纹理变软。

en-US.name: FXAA
en-US.summary: Fast spatial antialiasing. Medium/High/Ultra change edge-search presets; check for softened text and texture.

zh-Hans.name: NIS
zh-Hans.summary: NIS 同时缩放与锐化，NVSharpen 只做同尺寸锐化；HDR 下请比较高光和颜色。

en-US.name: NIS
en-US.summary: NIS scales and sharpens; NVSharpen only sharpens at the same size. Compare highlights and color in HDR.

zh-Hans.name: NNEDI3
zh-Hans.summary: 固定 2× 神经插值。nns 是神经元数量，win 是采样窗口；更大规格增加计算量，不保证更适合每种素材。

en-US.name: NNEDI3
en-US.summary: Fixed 2× neural interpolation. nns is neuron count and win is the sampling window; larger variants add work, without guaranteeing a better match.

zh-Hans.name: RAVU
zh-Hans.summary: 普通／Lite 为 2×，3x 为 3×，Zoom 为自由尺寸。R 是采样规格，AR 抑制振铃，RGB 同时重建颜色通道。

en-US.name: RAVU
en-US.summary: Regular/Lite use 2×, 3x uses 3×, and Zoom supports flexible sizes. R denotes sampling size, AR limits ringing, and RGB reconstructs color channels.

zh-Hans.name: SMAA
zh-Hans.summary: Low～Ultra 是空间预设；T2x／4x 使用捕获帧历史，NoJitter 去掉额外采样抖动。时序变体需检查重影。

en-US.name: SMAA
en-US.summary: Low–Ultra are spatial presets. T2x/4x use captured-frame history; NoJitter removes extra sampling jitter. Check temporal variants for ghosting.

zh-Hans.name: xBR
zh-Hans.summary: 平滑像素画轮廓：LV2 为 2×～4×；NoBlend 3× 保留输入调色板；Hybrid 2× 用于已抗锯齿的 SDR 素材。

en-US.name: xBR
en-US.summary: Smooth pixel-art outlines: LV2 offers 2×–4×, NoBlend 3× preserves the input palette, and Hybrid 2× targets antialiased SDR content.

zh-Hans.name: xBRZ
zh-Hans.summary: 2×～6× 为固定整数倍率，Freescale 可设置目标尺寸。平滑轮廓会改变像素网格，请与最近邻比较。

en-US.name: xBRZ
en-US.summary: 2×–6× are fixed integer scales; Freescale accepts a target size. Smoother outlines change the pixel grid, so compare with nearest-neighbor scaling.

zh-Hans.name: XeSS Frame Generation
zh-Hans.summary: 生成 2×～4× 显示帧，可选光流。非 Intel 显卡的 3×／4× 使用本项目实验兼容路径。

en-US.name: XeSS Frame Generation
en-US.summary: Generate 2×–4× displayed frames with optional optical flow. 3×/4× on non-Intel GPUs uses this project’s experimental compatibility path.

zh-Hans.name: CuNNy 原版
zh-Hans.summary: 原版 2× 模型，按层数和通道数选择；DN 用于带噪声素材，干净线稿可比较普通版。

en-US.name: CuNNy original
en-US.summary: Original 2× models, selected by layers and channels. DN targets noisy content; compare regular variants on clean line art.

zh-Hans.name: CuNNy2
zh-Hans.summary: CuNNy2 的 2× 模型；fast 系列偏向较少计算，数字规格按网络规模选择。

en-US.name: CuNNy2
en-US.summary: CuNNy2 2× models. The fast series targets less computation; numbered variants specify network size.

zh-Hans.name: ACNet
zh-Hans.summary: 动画 2× 放大，同时减轻噪声。
zh-Hans.details:

HDR 下使用 SDR 兼容转换，请比较高光、颜色与渐变。

en-US.name: DLSSNR AI Filter
en-US.summary: AI texture reshaping with up to three passes.
en-US.details:
Reshapes textures and detail while keeping the final output at the input size. Select 1–3 serial passes with independent style and intensity; extra passes add cost and can accumulate texture changes. Usually resize first, reshape next, then sharpen gently.

In SDR, enabling Adjust Input Resolution activates controls for the total change from the original: overall strength, chroma, lightness, protection, and frequency ranges. They apply once after all passes. Lower input percentages change the working size and texture response. The HDR path does not support these input-size or detail controls.

Requires an NVIDIA GPU, driver, and bundled runtime that can initialize this experimental feature. A single-pass initialization failure may pass through; multipass failure rejects startup. Successful startup does not guarantee reshaping is active.

Style and intensity can update live; pass count, anti-flicker, input size, and optical flow require restarting scaling. Anti-flicker aims to reduce frame-to-frame changes; check motion ghosting, colors, and highlights.

issueDefinitions.long-or-technical-product-copy: Replace repeated compilation requirements, implementation detail, and historical-review prose with purpose, variants, placement, sizes, and necessary constraints.
issueDefinitions.bilingual-terminology-and-scope: Author matching current guidance in both languages; jitter means sampling offset, not camera shake.
issueDefinitions.recommendation-confused-cost-with-maturi: Separate processing cost from integration maturity and choose tags by scenario and setup complexity.
issueDefinitions.missing-serial-passes: Describe 1–3 serial DLSSNR passes with independent per-pass settings.
issueDefinitions.detail-controls-activation: SDR detail controls need input-resolution adjustment and apply once to the final total change.
issueDefinitions.unverified-driver-and-gpu-list: Do not present the historical user-supplied compatibility list as an officially verified universal requirement.
issueDefinitions.single-vs-multipass-failure: Single-pass creation can fall back to passthrough; multipass failure rejects creation.
issueDefinitions.unified-frame-refresh-guidance: Use the unified Frame rate and refresh entry; distinguish base FPS from displayed FPS.
issueDefinitions.family-training-difference-not-network-s: General and LineArt use different trained weights in the installed variants.
issueDefinitions.jitter-is-sampling-offset-not-camera-sha: NoJitter still uses frame history; only the additional sampling shift is removed.
